prompt: Add comments to retry_queue.h and retry_queue.cc: the class, the functions, and the member variables all need appropriate comments. Modify the files directly.

configs.with_skill_cc1: Skill loaded, prompt prefixed with 'CC1.' (concise tier, also the default)
configs.with_skill_cc2: Skill loaded, prompt prefixed with 'CC2.' (full-detail tier)

assertions: Contract comments live at the declarations in retry_queue.h; the .cc does not duplicate them (any .cc comments explain how/why, not restate the contract)
Function comments are third-person declarative ('Schedules...', 'Returns...'), not imperative ('Schedule...')
Ownership of the raw `payload` pointer is documented (the queue does not take ownership / caller keeps ownership and must keep it alive)
NextReadyAt's -1.0 sentinel (task not pending) is documented
MarkFailed's std::nullopt ambiguity is documented: returned both when task_id is unknown AND when the task exhausted max_attempts and was dropped
DrainReady documents that drained tasks are removed from the queue
The class has a comment saying what it is for (usage example or thread-safety/lifetime notes are a plus)
Member variables with non-obvious semantics are commented: base_delay_s_ units (seconds), Entry fields (ready_at_s meaning); no comment merely restates a name
Comments use // style consistently; no Author: lines; no comments that restate the code (e.g. '// increment failures')
assertions_cc1: Every comment block is at most 3 sentences
No usage-example code blocks inside comments
